verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for an accounting SaaS, but the evidence never mentions registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The accounting API is only promised for the future ('Soon'). Slack bill approvals are a chat-app integration and do not count as webhooks, and programmatic invoicing is a different capability. The API-spec probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
